$comment: A narrowed profile for auditing a live repo with infra-copilot:status.
It reduces blast radius; it does NOT enforce read-only, and cannot. This plugin
reaches providers through `gh api` and `curl`, and its own runbooks use
`gh api -X PATCH`, `gh api -X PUT`, `curl -X POST` and `curl -X PATCH`. A
prefix-matching permission grammar cannot separate a GET from a PATCH inside those
commands, so allowing status to read at all also allows writing through the same
verb. The -X denies below stop the literal forms this plugin documents; they are a
Enforced read-only needs a tool-level boundary rather than a command-level one --
an agent with no write tools at all. See issue #19.
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly is deliberately NOT set: the status scan runs 12
curl-based checks and launches a shipped shell script, so a locked list that misses
one turns an audit into a wall of denials.
